pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:216 A prefer steer for leonardo-studio replaces the plan with a vendor PLAN never lists, so the steer leaves the capability table instead of only reordering inside it.

techniques.evidence: lib/imaging/router.ts:216 Prefer of a PREFER_ONLY id becomes the whole chain even though PLAN does not list it; avoid-empties-the-chain and the env table are otherwise present.

lib/imaging/errors.ts:112 Timeout and vendor failure do not hop; Leonardo COMPLETE with zero images is thrown as bad-response at lib/imaging/providers/leonardo.ts:246, not as refused. Google empty output is refused.
lib/imaging/providers/google.ts:216 The edit body omits image_size, so the vendor's own size default ships with no trail entry; the four in-chain eliminations and reroutedFrom are otherwise recorded.
lib/imaging/pricing.ts:244 A row with no figure stays unpriced and carries its recorded reason; priced rows bind source, checked date, and atSize.
lib/imaging/router.ts:83 Dev generate puts agy first with no usable-output grid; the 26/30 vs 7/30 measurement above ranks google over leonardo only. The pre-call ceiling itself is present.
lib/imaging/providers/google.ts:53 Every Google generate pins one process-global size; the comment above names 0.5K–4K and a doubling price, and GenerateRequest has no stage or size field.
lib/imaging/router.ts:180 Traffic that never served the plan's first provider is reported, and budgetStats.underFloor reports a band breach without refusing the call.
lib/imaging/router.ts:99 Recognize is ordered ollama then google because the local eye is free; the plan does not cite a truth-set score or skip ollama on unresolved fields.

pairs.registryProposal: The steer contract has no closed form for a vendor that must be named to run and must not fall through onto a dollar-billed vendor; PREFER_ONLY is that form, and the standard currently treats any steer outside the plan as a violation.
